text.holdout_caveat: Each family's strategies were frozen before their own holdout test and are unchanged here. But all three holdout results had been seen before this page combined them (the mean-reversion pair lost), and the third-per-family split was chosen afterwards, so this view is a description, not a fresh test: don't use it to pick a mix.
text.val_caveat: Not clean for any family: every one was picked with its 2023–2024 results in view (the noise-band and squeeze strategies directly on them). It shows how they held up, not proof.
